title: Worker scalar deleting destructor
summary: Recovers VA 0x48DB80 as a thiscall member with explicit original 32-bit layout and portable import bindings. Restores base vtable 0x9FBE20, closes the saved +8 handle, conditionally deallocates on flag bit 0, and returns this. Original vtable slot 0 points here; neighboring slots are start and worker entry. No direct static caller was found in disassembly; virtual dispatch is evidenced by the vtable.
test_description: 5120 original-versus-recovered comparisons: all 256 low flag bytes with high-bit variants, five handles including zero and -1, successful/failed close results, and callbacks that mutate the vtable/handle. Checks return pointer, callback arguments/order/count, vtable state at callbacks, complete fixture equality, untouched priority/thread ID and surrounding canaries.
known_limits: CloseHandle and operator delete are controlled callbacks; OS/CRT internals and actual deallocation are not validated.
Only the observed 16-byte base layout is named; full derived-object types remain unresolved.
Null or invalid object pointers are outside the original routine's valid input contract; it unconditionally dereferences this.
Original vtable address is retained as a 32-bit token; a Linux port must bind imports and integrate its own virtual dispatch.
